label: base
desc: Check frame time at the Kokiri spawn and on the walk with default settings

label: trace-stutter
desc: Check what causes the walk hitch with Lichii's stutter trace (hitches over 200 ms explained)

label: trace-idle
desc: Check where the GPU idles each frame with the back-idle, present-fence and acquire traces

label: vsync-immediate
desc: Check if vsync Immediate lifts the 120 fps cap and shortens the load, and its frame time

label: frames-ahead-0
desc: Check frame time when the game may not run a frame ahead of the GPU (frames-ahead 0)

label: gpu-clock-normal
desc: Check frame time and picture with the GPU clock at Normal instead of Boost

label: gpu-clock-overclock
desc: Check frame time and picture with the GPU clock at Overclock instead of Boost

label: cpu-clock-boost
desc: Check frame time with the CPU clock at Boost instead of Normal

label: keep-encoder
desc: Check if keeping Metal encoders open across barriers saves GPU time (MVK_P60_KEEP_ENCODER)

label: fastmath-always
desc: Check frame time when every Metal shader is compiled with fast math

label: fastmath-never
desc: Check frame time when no Metal shader is compiled with fast math
